```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
      - 'AGENTS.md'

jobs:
  setup-copilot:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.x'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install pre-commit

      - name: Run pre-commit on all files
        run: pre-commit run --all-files

      - name: Create AGENTS.md
        run: |
          echo "## Pre-commit Workflow Configuration" > AGENTS.md
          echo "" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "### Command Invocation and Triggers" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "The pre-commit workflow is triggered automatically before each commit." >> AGENTS.md
          echo "" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "### Prerequisites" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "- Ensure `pre-commit` is installed in your development environment." >> AGENTS.md
          echo "" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "### Usage Patterns" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "To run pre-commit on all files, execute the following command:" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "```\npre-commit run --all-files\n```" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "Alternatively, you can run pre-commit on only the staged files using:" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "```\npre-commit run --staged\n```" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "### Reference to .pre-commit-config.yaml" >> AGENTS.md
          echo "For detailed information about the hooks configured in pre-commit, refer to the [.pre-commit-config.yaml] file." >> AGENTS.md
```
